text: At its June 8 and 9, 2021 meeting, City Council directed Parks, Forestry and Recreation to provide an update to the Infrastructure and Environment Committee on the results of stakeholder consultations related to the environmentally and culturally sensitive dispersal of funeral ashes at municipal parks and waterways. By identifying sites that are most suitable for this practice and working with stakeholder groups to provide appropriate visitor education, the City can help ensure the privacy and dignity of bereaved community members, maintain park areas in good condition and limit the risk of user conflict on Toronto's busy waterfront. The Infrastructure and Environment Committee received the report (April 7, 2022) from the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation for information.
